header.title: AI Detector
header.description: Analyze any text to determine if it was written by AI or a human. Get a confidence score and a sentence-by-sentence breakdown.

sentence.title: Sentence-Level Analysis
sentence.description: Every sentence is scored individually and colour-coded as Human, Mixed, or AI — not just an overall number.

confidence.title: Confidence Score
confidence.description: A percentage score from 0–100 shows how likely the text is AI-generated, with a visual human-vs-AI bar.

pdf.title: PDF Report Export

items.teachers: Teachers verifying whether student submissions were written by AI

items.length: Paste at least 200 words for a reliable result — very short text produces inconclusive scores.
items.midRange: A score of 40–60% usually means AI-assisted rather than fully AI-generated.
items.humanize: Humanize your AI drafts first, then re-check — target under 30% for a safe result.
items.highlights: Sentence-level highlights show which specific sentences raised the score — edit those first.

accuracy.question: How accurate is the AI detector?
accuracy.answer: No AI detector is 100% accurate, including this one. Treat the score as a signal worth investigating rather than proof — very formal or formulaic human writing can be flagged, and edited AI text can slip through.

breakdown.question: What does the sentence-by-sentence breakdown show?
breakdown.answer: Every sentence is scored individually and labeled human, mixed, or AI. This lets you see exactly which passages drive the overall score instead of judging the whole document at once.

interpret.question: How should I interpret the overall score?
interpret.answer: It is a likelihood estimate, not a verdict. A low score means the writing shows mostly human-like patterns, a high score means it strongly resembles AI output, and mid-range scores usually indicate mixed or edited text.

export.question: Can I export the results?
export.answer: Yes. You can download a PDF report that includes the overall verdict and the per-sentence analysis, which is useful for sharing or record-keeping.

cost.question: How much does a check cost?
cost.answer: Token cost scales with text length at roughly 1 text token per 6 characters. Your remaining balance is shown in the navbar after each run.

falsePositives.question: Can human writing be falsely flagged as AI?
falsePositives.answer: Yes. Uniform, highly polished, or template-like writing sometimes triggers false positives. Never rely on a detector score alone as evidence that someone used AI.
